definition.title: Listening practice
definition.subtitle: A change in the surroundings · 1 · preparation 1
definition.context: Use this subset of the nature vocabulary and constructions in a short self-contained situation, preparing for U6-28. Use the selected vocabulary and constructions to connect an observation about a place or environment with a practical decision.

questions.prompt: What assumption leads the sister to add more water?
questions.label: Listen for meaning
questions.hint: Check the evidence and the limits of the conclusion.

choices.hanzi: 包装要求土一直保持非常潮湿。
choices.feedback: She jumps from one visible outcome to a cause without checking other conditions.

choices.hanzi: 没有叶子就一定是水不够。
choices.feedback: She jumps from one visible outcome to a cause without checking other conditions.

choices.hanzi: 朋友已经检查并确认土太干。
choices.feedback: She jumps from one visible outcome to a cause without checking other conditions.

questions.prompt: What does rereading the instructions establish?
questions.label: Listen for meaning
questions.hint: Check the evidence and the limits of the conclusion.

choices.hanzi: 任何植物都应该每天增加同样的水。
choices.feedback: The instructions add both a time requirement and a limit on watering.

choices.hanzi: 只要等待，位置和天气就完全不重要。
choices.feedback: The instructions add both a time requirement and a limit on watering.

choices.hanzi: 还需要正常等待，太多的水也可能不利。
choices.feedback: The instructions add both a time requirement and a limit on watering.

questions.prompt: Why does the appearance of leaves not prove the last watering caused success?
questions.label: Listen for meaning
questions.hint: Check the evidence and the limits of the conclusion.

choices.hanzi: 从播种到生长本来需要时间，不能只看最近一次动作。
choices.feedback: A later outcome cannot be attributed solely to the most recent intervention.

choices.hanzi: 姐姐在整个过程中从来没有浇过水。
choices.feedback: A later outcome cannot be attributed solely to the most recent intervention.

choices.hanzi: 朋友已经保证任何一次加水都必然有害。
choices.feedback: A later outcome cannot be attributed solely to the most recent intervention.

definition.summary: Your results distinguish checked answers from self-reviewed practice. Unsampled material and unassessed proficiency remain separate.

paragraphs.text: 姐姐第一次在阳台播种，天天去看有没有新的叶子。过了几天没有变化，她觉得一定是水不够，便又浇了一次，直到土一直很潮湿。
paragraphs.pinyin: jiě jie dì yī cì zài yáng tái bō zhǒng ， tiān tiān qù kàn yǒu méi yǒu xīn de yè zi 。 guò le jǐ tiān méi yǒu biàn huà ， tā jué de yī dìng shì shuǐ bù gòu ， biàn yòu jiāo le yī cì ， zhí dào tǔ yī zhí hěn cháo shī 。

paragraphs.text: 朋友来看时，先问她播种的日期、放的位置和浇水的次数。姐姐只想知道要不要继续加水，朋友却说，不能只凭没有叶子就判断原因。
paragraphs.pinyin: péng you lái kàn shí ， xiān wèn tā bō zhǒng de rì qī 、 fàng de wèi zhì hé jiāo shuǐ de cì shù 。 jiě jie zhǐ xiǎng zhī dào yào bù yào jì xù jiā shuǐ ， péng you què shuō ， bù néng zhǐ píng méi yǒu yè zi jiù pàn duàn yuán yīn 。

paragraphs.text: 她们把包装上的说明重新读了一遍，发现现在还没到通常长出叶子的时间。说明也提醒，土过于潮湿并不适合植物生长，不是水越多越好。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā men bǎ bāo zhuāng shàng de shuō míng chóng xīn dú le yī biàn ， fā xiàn xiàn zài hái méi dào tōng cháng zhǎng chū yè zi de shí jiān 。 shuō míng yě tí xǐng ， tǔ guò yú cháo shī bìng bù shì hé zhí wù shēng zhǎng ， bù shì shuǐ yuè duō yuè hǎo 。

paragraphs.text: 姐姐停止不断加水，记录每天的情况，等到土和天气的条件合适时再处理。她没有把等待当作什么都不做，而是开始仔细观察实际变化。
paragraphs.pinyin: jiě jie tíng zhǐ bù duàn jiā shuǐ ， jì lù měi tiān de qíng kuàng ， děng dào tǔ hé tiān qì de tiáo jiàn hé shì shí zài chǔ lǐ 。 tā méi yǒu bǎ děng dài dàng zuò shén me dōu bù zuò ， ér shì kāi shǐ zǐ xì guān chá shí jì biàn huà 。

paragraphs.text: 后来，小叶子终于出现。姐姐很高兴，却没有说这是因为自己最后一次浇水特别有效；从播种到长出叶子，本来就需要一段时间。
paragraphs.pinyin: hòu lái ， xiǎo yè zi zhōng yú chū xiàn 。 jiě jie hěn gāo xìng ， què méi yǒu shuō zhè shì yīn wèi zì jǐ zuì hòu yī cì jiāo shuǐ tè bié yǒu xiào ； cóng bō zhǒng dào zhǎng chū yè zi ， běn lái jiù xū yào yī duàn shí jiān 。

paragraphs.text: 下一次，她先看清楚说明再开始，也留出可以等待的时间。朋友说，愿意照顾很重要，知道什么时候应该先观察，也是照顾的一部分。
paragraphs.pinyin: xià yī cì ， tā xiān kàn qīng chu shuō míng zài kāi shǐ ， yě liú chū kě yǐ děng dài de shí jiān 。 péng you shuō ， yuàn yì zhào gù hěn zhòng yào ， zhī dào shén me shí hou yīng gāi xiān guān chá ， yě shì zhào gù de yī bù fen 。
